item.title: [6.8] MT Forcing: Towards Stable and Consistent Multi-Turn Image Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Multi-turn image editing aims to modify an image according to a sequence of instructions, enabling more effective interactive visual content creation for users. However, existing methods often exhibit noticeable drift after only a few editing turns, manifesting in two aspects: 1) unstable visual quality, with accumulating artifacts and degraded details; and 2) inconsistent image content, with...

WHY IT MATTERS

MT Forcing introduces a clever technical solution (Single-Turn DMD and Teacher-Forcing Guidance) to mitigate error accumulation in multi-turn image editing, addressing a key limitation of current autoregressive diffusion models.
